metadata.purpose: Prior-state audit trail for Harris GC corpus v1.4.0 correction
metadata.note: Historical values are separated from the released corpus so stale values cannot be indexed or returned as current data.

distances.frame_note: x_kpc/y_kpc/z_kpc regenerated in v1.3.3 as heliocentric Cartesian coordinates derived from this record's own r_sun_kpc, position.l_deg and position.b_deg via x=r cos(b) cos(l), y=r cos(b) sin(l), z=r sin(b). The previous values were Galactocentric (Baumgardt et al. 2023 frame) stored in a heliocentric field, which is inconsistent with the 131 records where |xyz| equals r_sun_kpc. Prior values preserved under _pre_frame_fix.

distances.provenance_note: distances block repaired in v1.3.3. In v1.3.1/v1.3.2 a fixed-width parse of Harris (1996, 2010 ed.) shifted this block by one field on rows whose alt_name contains a space: r_sun_kpc held galactic latitude, r_gc_kpc held the heliocentric distance, x_kpc held the Galactocentric distance. Values here are from Baumgardt et al. 2023 (v4 database), NOT Harris 1996 -- a provenance difference from unaffected records in this corpus. Verified to use the same xyz sign convention as the Harris values it replaces.
